text:
billing_ops: Noticing our weekly revenue report is undercounting refunds. The Stripe refund total for last 7 days in the dashboard is $9,800 but the finance report shows $6,400. Looks like ~3.4k missing. Anyone seen this?

reporting_bot: report_run: weekly_revenue_2026-03-22 completed status=completed rows=142 generated_at=2026-03-22T07:00:12Z

finance_engineer: Which pipeline is the report using? We have two refund sources: raw stripe events and the reconciled ns_refunds table. One of them strips partial refunds grouped by original charge id.

billing_ops: The missing refunds are mostly partial refunds (3 customers). Example: stripe ref refund_1KxA refunded $1,150 on ch_3Lk; our report shows $0 for that refund.

stripe_bot: stripe_event: refund.refunded id=refund_1KxA amount=115000 created=2026-03-18T19:02:44Z status=succeeded metadata={"invoice":"INV-2026-0870"}

finance_engineer: Can you paste the raw events in the DLQ or logs? I want to confirm idempotency keys and whether our webhook consumer dropped them.

eng_infra: Quick check: webhook consumer restarted 2026-03-18T19:05Z for a config rollout. We saw a transient 503 to the /webhooks/stripe endpoint and consumer retried. The consumer dedupe relies on header Idempotency-Key. Stripe does not include idempotency for refund events by default. On retries we may have stored an upstream placeholder and later reconciliation dedupe removed partials.

reporting_bot: log_snippet: 2026-03-18T19:06 consumer: processed evt refund_1KxA status=ok wrote to raw_events table txn_id=tx_8342
reporting_bot: log_snippet: 2026-03-18T19:06 consumer: acked stripe delivery id=del_21J

finance_engineer: Hypothesis: our reconciliation job that builds ns_refunds collapses refunds by original_charge_id and then takes max(amount) instead of sum(amount), so partial refunds after initial refund get ignored. That would explain missing partials.

acct_mgr: If that's true some customers didn't get credit memos in NetSuite. We need to check INV-2026-0870 and a couple others. Can collections hold off adjustments until resolved?

billing_ops: Pausing automated dunning for those invoices now. Listing affected invoices: INV-2026-0870 (alice+prod), INV-2026-0922 (boldly), INV-2026-0931 (forge-ai).

cfo: Estimate exposure? total missing refund amount = $3,400. Does that affect recognized revenue? Possibly deferrals.

eng_infra: Found the aggregation step in /services/reporting/src/refunds_agg.py: ```# BUG: grouping by charge_id and picking max refund_amount
GROUP BY original_charge_id
SELECT original_charge_id, max(refund_amount) as refund_amount
``` Should be sum(refund_amount). I'll open a hotfix PR.

finance_engineer: Nice catch. Two changes needed: 1) fix aggregation to sum, 2) backfill the reconciled table and re-run revenue report. Backfill script: ```./bin/backfill_refunds --from 2026-03-15 --to 2026-03-22 --target reconciled_refunds```

eng_infra: I'll land the PR and deploy to staging for quick verification. Recommend backfill on the weekend or low-traffic window, but since this affects collections hold we've paused dunning so we can run earlier.

billing_ops: Also check NetSuite side - if NS already posted credit memos for the first partial refund, posting backfilled refunded amounts may create duplicates unless we map by stripe_refund_id.

netsuite_bot: ns_sync: reconcile_attempt refund_1KxA -> ns_creditmemo CM-2026-2107 status=found mapped_by=stripe_refund_id

finance_engineer: Good point. The backfill should upsert by stripe_refund_id on reconciled_refunds and the NS sync should be idempotent. I'll add upsert behavior and include audit notes.

acct_mgr: After backfill, can we generate a short report for customer outreach? I can use that to email customers who may have seen old balances. Template ready.

cfo: Keep me posted. Please include estimated delta to MRR and recognized ARR if material.

eng_infra: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/services/pull/4826 patch: change max->sum, add unit test for multiple partial refunds per charge. Deploying to staging now.

finance_engineer: Running backfill dry-run now: ```./bin/backfill_refunds --from 2026-03-15 --to 2026-03-22 --dry-run``` Will post results in this thread.

billing_ops: Thanks. tagging @acct_mgr @cfo. We'll keep collections paused for the 3 invoices until confirmed. :white_check_mark:
